extDesc.message: 2FAuthenticator generates two-factor authentication codes right in your browser.

next_code.description: Next code of a counter based account.

encrypted.description: Code of an account that is not decrypted.

invalid.description: Code of an account with an invalid secret.

remind_backup.message: Without a copy, your codes are lost together with the browser profile.

no_entries_info.message: Scan a QR code on the open page or enter the secret key manually.

add_qr_info.message: Select the QR code on the open page

add_secret_info.message: Secret key from the service settings

import_link.message: Import from a file or another app
import_link.description: Import link of the empty list.

account_actions.description: Context menu of an account card.

group_none.description: Section of the accounts without a group.

group_suggestions.description: Existing groups under the group field.

group_actions.description: Context menu of a group header.

group_name.description: Group name field in the rename dialog.

ungroup_text.message: Its accounts move to “No group”. The accounts themselves are not deleted.

merge_groups_text.message: Group “$GROUP$” already exists. Accounts of both groups will be in it.

edit_account.description: Context menu item that opens the account page.

passphrase_info.message: Enter your password to decrypt the codes.

site_invalid.message: Enter a website address, for example github.com

site_icon.description: Website icon toggle of an account.

show_qr.description: Show the QR code of an account.

account_locked_hint.message: Enter your password to edit this account. Only deletion is available now.
account_locked_hint.description: Account page of an account that is not decrypted.

qr_hint.message: Scan it with the app on your phone. Do not show this code to anyone.

confirm_delete.message: The account $ACCOUNT$ will disappear from the list. This cannot be undone. Without a backup or another way to sign in, you may lose access to the service.

import_header.message: Import, opens in a new tab
import_header.description: Import section of the add page.

import_backup_file_info.description: Import from a backup file hint.

backup.description: Backup menu item and page title.

security.description: Security menu item and page title.

settings.description: Settings menu item and page title.

sync_clock_info.message: If codes don't work: check the time against Google

version.description: Version at the bottom of the menu.

use_autofill_info.message: When you copy a code, it is also typed into the active field of the page

smart_filter_info.message: Show only the accounts of the open site. Set an account's website on its page. Check the site address before entering a code

site_icons_info.message: Show the icon of the account's website instead of the letter. Icons are loaded from the websites themselves

browser_sync_info.message: Accounts are kept in the browser's sync storage and appear on your other devices

password_set_info.message: Codes are encrypted; after locking, the password is required

password_not_set_info.message: Codes are stored unencrypted. Set a password to encrypt them

security_warning.message: A forgotten password cannot be recovered: without it, the codes cannot be decrypted.

download_enc_backup_info.message: .json file, opens only with the password

download_backup_info.message: otpauth:// text, works with other apps

export_info.message: Anyone who gets this file gets your codes.

phrase_incorrect_export.message: Accounts that could not be decrypted are not included in the backup.
phrase_incorrect_export.description: Backup of accounts that are not decrypted.

import_backup_info.message: From a backup file, QR images or text

otp_backup_inform.message: Add accounts from a backup or another app. Accounts you already have will stay.

import_file_choose.message: Choose a file or drop it here

import_file_info.message: A .json backup from 2FAuthenticator or Authenticator, including an encrypted one, or a text file with otpauth:// links

import_qr_choose.message: Choose images or drop them here

import_backup_qr_in_batches.message: You can select several images at once.

import_google_hint.message: Moving from Google Authenticator? Export your accounts as QR codes, take screenshots and open the “QR images” tab.

import_file_password.message: This backup is encrypted. Enter the password it was saved with.
import_file_password.description: Password of an encrypted backup file.

import_error_password.message: Accounts are locked. Open the extension, enter your password and try again.

options_info.message: Theme, password, backup and other settings are in the extension popup: toolbar icon → menu.

delete_all_warning.message: All accounts, the password and settings will be deleted, including the browser's sync storage. They can be restored only from a backup, so save a copy first.

confirm_delete_all.message: I understand that the data will be deleted irrecoverably

clock_too_far_off.message: Your clock is more than 5 minutes off. Fix the system time first.

phrase_incorrect.message: Not all accounts are decrypted. Enter the password first.

capture_failed.message: Could not start scanning. Reload the page and try again.

capture_unsupported.message: QR codes cannot be scanned on this page. Open the page with the QR code and try again.
capture_unsupported.description: Capture on a page where scripts cannot run.

capture_local_file_failed.message: Scanning a QR code from a local file? Open image import instead?

added.description: Added Account, after the account name.

migration_fail.message: Import failed. If you are moving from Google Authenticator, export the accounts again and retry.

import_backup_qr_partly_failed.message: Import done, but some QR codes were not recognized.

drive_connect_info.message: The encrypted copy updates itself after every change

drive_about.message: The extension sees only its own folder “2FAuthenticator” in Drive. The copy is always encrypted: with the extension password, or with a separate backup password when there is none.
drive_about.description: Backup page: what Drive backups are.

drive_unavailable.message: Google Drive is not available in this build.
drive_unavailable.description: Drive: the build has no OAuth client.

drive_status_network.message: Waiting to upload: no connection to Google Drive

drive_status_quota.message: Waiting to upload: Google Drive is full

drive_status_consent.message: Firefox needs a permission to transfer data

drive_status_unlock.message: Enter the extension password to save a copy

drive_disconnect_text.message: The extension stops saving copies and gives up its access to Drive. The copies stay in Drive.

drive_footer_password.message: The copy updates a minute after changes, the last 30 days are kept. It is encrypted with the extension password.

drive_footer_backup.message: The copy updates a minute after changes, the last 30 days are kept. It is encrypted with the backup password.

drive_retired.message: Copies up to $DATE$ open with the backup password
drive_retired.description: Drive: the backup password was replaced by the extension password.

drive_skipped.message: Not in the copy, no key: $COUNT$

drive_up_to_date.message: The copy is up to date

drive_nothing_to_save.message: There are no accounts to save

drive_error_signin.message: Google no longer accepts the sign-in of the extension. Sign in again.

drive_banner_signin_text.message: Changes are not saved to Drive: Google no longer accepts the sign-in of the extension.

drive_banner_consent_text.message: Firefox asks for your permission to send the encrypted copy to Google Drive.

drive_banner_password_title.message: Google Drive: set a backup password

drive_banner_password_text.message: Without the extension password, copies are encrypted with a backup password.

drive_banner_unlock_title.message: Google Drive: enter the extension password to save a copy

drive_banner_unlock_text.message: Some accounts came without encryption, for example through sync. The copy waits until the extension is unlocked.

drive_banner_shrink_title.message: Google Drive: fewer accounts in the copy

drive_banner_shrink_text.message: There were $FROM$, now $TO$. Save this copy?

drive_copies_merge.message: Accounts from the copy are added to the current ones, matching ones are replaced.

drive_copies_kept.message: Each browser keeps its last 30 copies.

drive_copies_empty.message: There are no copies in the folder yet.

drive_restore_info.message: Enter the password the copy was encrypted with: the extension password or the backup password of that day.

drive_wrong_password.message: The password does not fit this copy.

drive_missing_key.message: The copy has no key to its accounts.

drive_unlock_first.message: Unlock the extension and try again.

drive_backup_password_info.message: Copies in Google Drive are encrypted with this password because the extension password is not set. The next copy is encrypted with the new password, earlier copies still open with the old one.

drive_password_warning.message: Copies cannot be restored without this password, and it cannot be reset. Remember the old one too: older copies need it.

drive_tab_lead.message: The extension will save an encrypted copy of your accounts to the folder “2FAuthenticator” in your Drive by itself. Other files in Drive are hidden from it.

drive_signin_info.message: Google asks you to pick an account and lets the extension see only the files it creates.

drive_step_password_info.message: The extension password is not set, so copies are encrypted with a separate password.

drive_step_password_set.message: Copies are encrypted with the extension password.

drive_password_strength.message: Copies cannot be restored without this password, and it cannot be reset. Anyone who gets into your Google account can try to guess it, so choose a long one.

drive_done.message: Done, you can close this tab.

drive_restore_hint.message: Moving accounts to this browser? Restore them from a copy: popup → “Backup and import” → “Restore”. You can set the backup password afterwards.

drive_consent_info.message: Firefox asks for a permission to send data: the encrypted copy goes to Google Drive.

drive_consent_denied.message: Without the permission to transfer data, Firefox does not let the extension upload copies.

drive_signin_failed.message: Could not sign in to Google. Try again.

drive_signin_again.description: Drive tab title for sign-in only.
